skills.name: Skill Creator
skills.summary: Create, edit, and improve Agent Skills — scaffold a SKILL.md from scratch, refine an existing skill, run evals, and optimize a skill's description for better triggering.

skills.name: MCP Builder
skills.summary: Guide for building high-quality MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers with well-designed tools, in Python (FastMCP) or Node/TypeScript (MCP SDK).

skills.name: Webapp Testing
skills.summary: Interact with and test local web apps using Playwright — verify frontend behavior, debug UI, capture screenshots, and read browser logs.

skills.name: Frontend Design
skills.summary: Guidance for distinctive, intentional visual design when building or reshaping UI — aesthetic direction, typography, and choices that avoid templated defaults.

skills.name: Brand Guidelines
skills.summary: Apply an organization's official brand colors and typography to any artifact. Resolves brand tokens from the project rather than assuming a fixed palette (adapted from the Anthropic original to be brand-agnostic).

skills.name: Internal Comms
skills.summary: Write internal communications in common company formats — status reports, leadership updates, 3P updates, newsletters, FAQs, incident reports, and project updates.

skills.name: Claude API
skills.summary: Reference for the Claude API / Anthropic SDK — model ids, pricing, params, streaming, tool use, MCP, agents, caching, token counting, and model migration.

skills.name: Check PR
skills.summary: Check a GitHub, GitLab, or Perforce PR/MR/CL for review comments, failing checks, and PR-body gaps. Use when inspecting, fixing, or preparing a change for submission.

skills.name: PR Report
skills.summary: Produce a maintainer-grade PR or contribution report as HTML or Markdown. Use when deeply reviewing a PR, explaining a design, comparing systems, or preparing a merge recommendation.

skills.name: Doc Maintenance
skills.summary: Audit README, SPEC, and PRODUCT docs against recent git history for drift and make minimal PR-ready edits. Use to review docs for accuracy after major merges or on a schedule.

skills.name: Evolve an App
skills.summary: Change an App Work the way its own App spec allows: branch per Task, the spec's checks, protected and human-merge paths, and a change that stays open until it is live.
